name: Camp Manitou
description_short: Overnight camp for boys ages 7 to 16 on East Pond in the Belgrade Lakes region, with an address in Oakland, Maine. Boys plan their own schedules across land sports, water sports and creative arts such as theater, radio and animation, in 3-week half sessions or a 7-week full session.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on East Pond. Sixteen instructional water activities include swimming, competitive swimming, sailing, water-skiing, wakeboarding, canoeing, kayaking and fishing. CPR, basic rescue and advanced lifesaving courses are offered.

sources.note: Summer address: 47 Camp Manitou Cove, Oakland, Maine 04963
Activities from the landsports, watersports and creative arts pages linked here
Escorted group flights and buses from Burlington MA, Port Chester NY and Fairfield CT, for a fee

source.title: Camp Manitou, Best Boys Summer Camp for Sports, Arts, Water

warnings: This is the camp's homepage only; it has no dates, prices or session details. Those are on the separate Sessions page.
The page mentions 'two back to back Covid-free summers', so some homepage content may be several years old.
Camp type is inferred as sleepaway ('summer home', Visiting Day, Little Brother Sleepover); the page does not state it outright.
The camp is for boys only. The site also mentions a sister camp and a short-session camp, which are not covered here.
A free one-day 'Fantasy Camp' trial is offered; this is separate from regular sessions.
